Description:

1.0.1
by onjulraz

[size=5]
This mod is currently out of date.  Please give me time to update it!

What is it?[/size]
Progressive Access Farm is a [b]single-player[/b] farm map for those wanting more challenge from early to mid game Stardew Valley!  

Players will start with only a tiny area accessible to them and [b]no access to water on the farm[/b], but with upgraded tools they will be able to expand their farm's production, have access to water and fishing spots, clear land for new buildings, and etc.  I recommend building a well as soon as possible!

This mod [b]uses the wilderness farm slot [/b]but turns off nighttime monster spawn.
While the mod is installed, old saves using the wilderness farm will be changed to this farm's layout.



[size=5]Install[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
Run the game using SMAPI.

---

To uninstall, simply remove the ProFarm folder from /Mods.



[size=5]How to use[/size]
Start a new game and choose the [b]Wilderness Farm [/b]type.  The rest is up to you!



[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]This farm map is not compatible with multiplayer!  There's no space for other players...
[/list]
